definitions.explanation: The quantitative relation between two amounts showing how many times one value contains another.

examples.japanese: {男女|だんじょ}の{比率|ひりつ}は{3|さん}{対|たい}{2|に}だ。
{売上|うりあげ}に{占|し}める{輸出|ゆしゅつ}の{比率|ひりつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The proportion of exports in sales is high.

examples.japanese: {高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{比率|ひりつ}が{年々|ねんねん}{増加|ぞうか}している。
examples.english: The proportion of elderly people is increasing year by year.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
{比|ひ} (compare) + {率|りつ} (rate) = ratio

COMMON TYPES:
・{男女比率|だんじょひりつ} - male-to-female ratio
・{人口比率|じんこうひりつ} - population ratio
・{自己資本比率|じこしほんひりつ} - equity ratio
・{配当比率|はいとうひりつ} - dividend ratio
・{構成比率|こうせいひりつ} - composition ratio

GRAMMAR:
・〜の{比率|ひりつ}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (the ratio of ~ is high/low)
・〜の{比率|ひりつ}を{上|あ}げる/{下|さ}げる (to raise/lower the ratio of ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{割合|わりあい} - proportion, rate (more common in daily speech)
・{比|ひ} - ratio (mathematical term)
・{比例|ひれい} - proportion (mathematical relationship)
・{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ} / パーセント - percentage
